name: build-brief
description: Compile plain-language software intent into a proportional design contract and gate supported local edits until it passes.

interface.shortDescription: Translate intent and gate edits behind design.
interface.longDescription: Build Brief translates non-trivial software requests and repository context into a proportional Design Contract before implementation. A local mutation guard allows focused inspection first, then gates supported write tools until the contract is recorded. Users can build automatically, review the contract first, or request a handoff-ready directive without coding.
defaultPrompt: Compile a proportional design contract, pass the mutation gate, then build this request.
Show me the design contract first and wait for approval before coding.
Turn this request into a handoff-ready engineering directive without coding.
